links.outcome: Proportion of CDSS non-adherence flags clinicians followed up versus not followed up
links.effect: 260 (78%) of flags were Not Followed-up; 71 (22%) were Followed-up. Anti-depressant flags were less likely to be followed up than Anti-Psychotic and Anxiolytic flags (p < 0.001).
links.quote: The majority of clients were Not Followed-up (n = 260; 78%; Followed-up: n = 71; 22%).

unlisted_practices: Incorporating consumer and carer input and non-EHR data streams into CDSS design to encourage clinician follow-up

screen.reason: Empirical observational study evaluating clinicians' actual follow-up behaviors and responses to automated non-adherence CDSS notifications in a real-world community mental health clinic.
